Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike several terrorist positions and continue their offensive to secure the national territory
Mali.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely pursuing their mission of defending territorial integrity and protecting populations. As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, units engaged on the ground maintain sustained operational pressure against armed terrorist groups, through surveillance, intelligence, reconnaissance and targeted strikes The latest operations, conducted on 3 and 4 November 2026 in several sectors of the national territory, testify to the continuity of the military commitment and the willingness of the military authorities to leave no space for the terrorist threat .

Mali.title: Orpaillage interdit en Guinée : Bamako et Ouagadougou s'accordent pour le retour de leurs ressortissants
Mali.summary: Des milliers d'orpailleurs maliens et burkinabè quittent la Guinée et refluent vers le Mali. Depuis la suspension de l'orpaillage artisanal décidée par les autorités guinéennes dans la zone de Siguiri, les localités maliennes frontalières voient arriver des convois de personnes contraintes de rentrer. Ce mercredi 4 novembre 2026, le Burkina Faso a dépêché une délégation ministérielle à Bamako, tandis que le Mali affirme avoir pris des dispositions pour accueillir et assister les personnes concernées.

Mali.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: the CNDH calls for the protection of migrants, especially children and young people
Mali.summary: The National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) is concerned about the arrival in Mali, since November 3, 2026, of many migrants mainly from gold mining sites in Guinea . In a communiqué published on 04 November 2026, the institution reminds the State of its obligations in terms of humanitarian assistance, based on the Malian Constitution and several international and African human rights protection texts.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Guinea: Ambassadors invited to a meeting in the context of operations in Siguiri
Mali.summary: Bamako, November 5 (AMAP) Guinean Foreign Minister Morissanda Kouyaté on Thursday invited heads of diplomatic missions accredited to Guinea to a meeting devoted to issues of common interest and the strengthening of international cooperation, in a context marked by the departure of foreign workers from the Siguiri region Announced in a statement dated 5 November, this meeting comes after the launch of operations against the uncontrolled exploitation of gold in this region of the north-east of the country.

Mali.title: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike...
Mali.summary: Koro, Sandaré, Sofara: the FAMa strike three terrorist positions in two days In a statement dated November 5, 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced two bases destroyed by precision strikes, near Koro and Sandaré, as well as a pair of terrorists on motorcycles targeted northwest of Sofara, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . The operations of surveillance, control and security of the territory continue.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Kouremalé : Les autorités du Faso saluent l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» à plus 40.000 orpailleurs burkinabè expulsés de Guinée
Mali.summary: Kangaba, 5 novembre (AMAP) Les autorités maliennes ont mobilisé leurs services pour porter assistance à plus de 40.000 ressortissants burkinabè expulsés de sites d’orpaillage en Guinée et arrivés à Kouremalé, dans la commune rurale de Benkadi. Le conseiller à l’ambassade du Burkina Faso au Mali, Ramdé Antoine, et le délégué au Conseil des Burkinabè de la région de Koulikoro, Daouda Ouattara, ont salué l’assistance «totale et inconditionnelle» des autorités maliennes, particulièrement celles de Kouremalé, a constaté l’AMAP.

Mali.title: Mali: President Goïta endows several defence services with new rolling means
Mali.summary: On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, proceeded, at the Koulouba Palace, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa strike terrorist bases near Koro, Sandaré and Sofara As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their allies continue to carry out missions to secure the country. The General Staff of the Armed Forces gave an update on several strikes carried out in recent days. On Tuesday, November 3, 2026, a terrorist base was spotted 52 kilometers northeast of Koro .

Mali.title: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces provides several defence services with new rolling means
Mali.summary: Nine (9) buses and six (6) pick-ups were handed over by the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces to the Armed Forces Social Service, the Banankoro NCO School (ESO), the Military Police, the Directorate of Armed Forces Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), the Special Operations Command (COS), the Directorate of Military Sports, the Staff School, the Military Police and the Directorate of Armed Forces Music .

Mali.title: Koulouba: the President of the Transition offers vehicles to the Defence Services
Mali.summary: On the occasion of the National Day of Wards this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, handed over nine buses and six pick-ups intended for the Defence Services, at the Koulouba Palace . These vehicles are intended in particular for the Social Service of the Armed Forces, the School of Non-Commissioned Officers of Banankoro, the Military Prytanée, the DIRPA, the Special Operations Command, the Military Police and the Directorate of the Music of the Armed Forces .

Mali.title: Rejected gold miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe
Mali.summary: Rejected miners from Guinea: Mali and Burkina Faso organize the return of Burkinabe The Malian Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, received on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 a Burkinabe delegation led by his counterpart, the Divisional Commissioner of Police Mahamadou Sana . The Burkinabe Minister of Family and Solidarity, Lieutenant-Colonel Passowendé Pélagie Kaboré, was also part of the delegation.

Mali.title: Koulouba: General Assimi GOÏTA hands over a batch of vehicles to several army departments
Mali.summary: Koulouba: the Supreme Chief of the Armed Forces endows several defense services with new rolling means On the sidelines of the commemoration of the National Day of Wards, this Wednesday, November 4, 2026, the President of the Transition, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, Head of State, proceeded, at the Palace of Koulouba, to the delivery of rolling means to several defense services .

Mali.title: Mali : Kouremalé face à l’afflux de milliers de personnes venues de la Guinée
Mali.summary: La suspension de l’orpaillage artisanal dans la préfecture de Siguiri, en Guinée, provoque le retour forcé de milliers d’orpailleurs étrangers, notamment maliens et burkinabè. Face à cet afflux, les autorités annoncent des mesures pour accueillir les personnes concernées, leur apporter une assistance et faciliter leur retour dans leurs pays respectifs. Dans un communiqué publié ce mardi 3 novembre, le Centre de coordination et de gestion des crises (CECOGEC) assure que des dispositions sont prises pour assister les ressortissants concernés et organiser leur retour.

Mali.title: MILITARY COURT OF BAMAKO: eight cases considered at the correctional hearing
Mali.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at its headquarters located in Dar Salam, in the 3rd district of the District of Bamako, its ordinary correctional hearing. A total of eight (08) cases were on the docket, involving several military and civilian personnel for various acts relating to Military Justice. The hearing was presided over by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his colleagues .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: in Soubo, a gold mine burned in retaliation for abuses against the Fulani, according to witnesses
Burkina Faso.summary: In a statement released on November 4, Human Rights Watch documented the September 1 JNIM attack on a gold mining site in northern Burkina Faso, which claimed the lives of 24 civilians.

Burkina Faso.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Burkina Faso.title: Orpailleurs expulsés de Guinée : Au moins quatre morts et une centaine de malades
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba, 5 novembre (AMAP)– Au moins quatre personnes ont perdu la vie et une centaine d’autres sont prises en charge au Centre de santé communautaire (CSCOM) de Kouremalé, parmi les milliers d’orpailleurs expulsés des sites d’exploitation aurifère de Siguiri, en Guinée. Certains des blessés soignés dans cette structure ont été atteints par des balles réelles.

Burkina Faso.title: Des milliers de Burkinabè rapatriés de Guinée après des mesures contre l’orpaillage illégal
Burkina Faso.summary: Les mines d’or de Guinée attirent de nombreux ressortissants ouest-africains, notamment des Burkinabè. Mais lundi, le gouvernement guinéen a annoncé l’interdiction formelle de l’exploitation artisanale de l’or dans plusieurs zones du nord-est du pays, ainsi que le déploiement permanent des forces de défense et de sécurité pour faire respecter cette mesure. Les autorités guinéennes n’ont toutefois pas communiqué sur ces mouvements de population.

Burkina Faso.title: Withdrawal of driving licences: about forty files examined
Burkina Faso.summary: La Direction générale des transports terrestres et maritimes (DGTTM) a tenu la troisième session foraine de la Commission technique spéciale de retrait du permis de conduire (CTSRPC), le lundi 26 octobre 2026, à la gare routière de Boromo. L’ouverture de la session de 48h a été présidée par le haut-commissaire de la province, Martin Bado, représentant le gouverneur de la région de Bankui.
